steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Measures of central tendency identify the "typical" or "middle" value in a dataset. The three main measures are the mean, median, and mode. | Definition: The IQR measures the spread of the middle 50% of data, removing the influence of the lowest 25% and highest 25% of values. It is more robust than the range because it ignores extreme values. | Definition: A box and whisker plot visually displays the median, quartiles, and range of a dataset. The "box" shows the IQR (Q1 to Q3), the line inside the box is the median, and the "whiskers" extend to the minimum and maximum values (or to 1.5 × IQR from the box, with outliers shown as individual points). | Common Error: Using the new value as the denominator instead of the original.
